title: Marlowe & Finch Gift Registry Visibility Setting
content:
The registrant of a Marlowe & Finch Gift Registry can switch the registry between public and private at any time while it is open; the settings available are those of the registry type's visibility settings (public and private for every type). A visibility change is made only while the registry is in active or completion status, as the registry record shows.

**Effects of a change**

- A private registry is still found by its registry number.
- Gifts bought before a change stay linked to the registry.

**Status test**

| Registry status on the registry record | Visibility can be changed |
|---|---|
| active | yes |
| completion | yes |
| closed | no |
| cancelled | no |

**Cases (hypothetical)**

- A registrant whose Graduation Registry is in completion status makes it private: the change is available, and guests who know the registry number still find it.
- A registrant whose Celebration Registry closed last month asks to make it public again: the registry is no longer in active or completion status, so the change is not available.
